title: Who's Next
producer: The Who; Glyn Johns, associate producer
studio_context: Olympic, Barnes, April to June 1971, and Stargroves with the Rolling Stones Mobile (Won't Get Fooled Again's backing track); Moon playing to Townshend's organ and VCS3 tracks.

drum_performances.name: Keith Moon
drum_performances.why_it_matters: His drumming 'more formal and less reliant on long drum fills' over the synthesiser tracks, and by Tony Fletcher's reckoning his best: Baba O'Riley's crash 2 ridden in eighths, Won't Get Fooled Again's open hats and little fills, and its re-entry after the organ.

notable_moments.description: Baba O'Riley: a crash 2 ridden in eighths, the crash on 1, the snare accented on 2 and 4.
Won't Get Fooled Again: round the toms over the kick in eighths into Daltrey's scream after the organ.
